name: Fantasy sports platform
note: A high-traffic sports fantasy platform with live scoring and real-money deposits and withdrawals, built at Logix Built Solutions.
problem: Thousands of people needed live scores during games, plus real-money deposits and withdrawals. Traffic surged when events started, and a payment bug would mean lost money and lost trust.

approach.title: Real-time scoring
approach.text: Socket.io pushes live score updates to thousands of clients at once.

approach.title: Two payment rails
approach.text: PayPal and Authorize.net, reconciled against each other.

approach.title: Transaction integrity
approach.text: Atomic wallet operations, so balances never drift under concurrent writes.

approach.title: Spikes
approach.text: Tuned for the traffic surge at the start of live events.

approach.title: Limits
approach.text: Server-side validation on every money movement.
